blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Maharlika Investment Corp. (MIC) is investing up to P900 million in Tubig Pilipinas Holdings Inc. to bolster the country’s water network. On Friday, Tubig Pilipinas said in a regulatory filing that it had inked a convertible note agreement with MIC, paving the way for the state-run group to invest an initial P450 million.
